class.name: WireMeshBuilderND
class.brief_description: Functions for creating and modifying ND wireframe meshes.
class.description: WireMeshBuilderND is a singleton for creating and modifying ND wireframe meshes. It contains all functions important enough to be included in the ND module, but too complex to be included in [ArrayWireMeshND], and not important enough to have their own dedicated types. For example, creating a subdivided box is handled by [BoxWireMeshND], not by this class.

method.name: extrude_linear
method.description: Extrudes a wireframe mesh linearly by creating 2 copies of the input mesh's data, translating one copy by the [param extrusion_vector] and the other copy by the negative of the [param extrusion_vector], and then connecting the corresponding vertices with edges. This operation is similar to Blender's "Mesh → Extrude → Extrude Faces" operation (hotkey "E"), but Blender's operation extrudes the 2D faces of a 3D mesh, while this function only operates on wireframe data in N-dimensional space.
